title: Theater event of the Fall just dropped!  Cannot wait for this!!!! #In...
transcript: It's official. In the Heights is coming back to New York as part of New York City Center's annual gala presentation. It is going to be playing a very short run from October 28th through November 8th, with casting to be announced at a later date. But with these annual galas, they are done in the style of the encores! series, meaning it's a concert staging, minimal rehearsal time, usually only two weeks. However, in recent years, they have felt very close to fully realised productions. And given that in the Heights is a show that doesn't need much of a set to begin with, I could see this feeling pretty close to a fully realised revival and would not be surprised if it also eyes a Broadway transfer. We have seen these galas transfer in the past, most recently ragtime. But we also had Parade, Sunday in the park with George, Pal Joey is having another life in D C. Right now. And so again purely speculation on my part, but I would not be surprised if this is paving the way for a true Broadway revival. And I'm just very excited to see the talent that they get for this. Because New York City center always gets the best cast, in part because of how short the entire process is, it's easier to get these big names to sign on. And the director is the director of Mexodus, which is currently playing off-Broadway. And I loved so I think He is an inspired choice, and I'm very excited to see what he does in this material.
classificationReason: Discussing the announcement of an In the Heights gala/return engagement at NYC Center. The show is not on the list, and the creator is sharing news/anticipation, not a first-hand review of a live production.
